mapper.insert: INSERT INTO place ( content_id, content_type_id, title, addr1, addr2, zipcode, mapx, mapy, first_image, first_image2, tel, created_at ) VALUES ( #{contentId}, #{contentTypeId}, #{title}, #{addr1}, #{addr2}, #{zipcode}, #{mapx}, #{mapy}, #{firstImage}, #{firstImage2}, #{tel}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title = #{title}, addr1 = #{addr1}, addr2 = #{addr2}, first_image = #{firstImage}, tel = #{tel}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM place ORDER BY title
SELECT * FROM place WHERE title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR title_ko LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY LENGTH(title) ASC LIMIT 5
